introduction: Minnesota Energy Assistance helps eligible households with home-energy costs. The 2026–27 application deadline is May 31, 2027.
description: Minnesota Energy Assistance helps eligible households with home-energy costs. The 2026–27 application deadline is May 31, 2027.

sections.who: Both renters and homeowners can apply. Income and household size affect eligibility.
sections.get: Payments support home heating and electricity costs. Tell the provider about emergency heating needs.
sections.docs:
• Household members and Social Security or alternative identification numbers.
  • Income documents and housing details.
  • Energy-company names, account numbers and emergency notices.
sections.apply:
1. Apply online or by mail

    Use Commerce’s application page. Online applications are available.

  2. Enter all energy accounts

    Provide heat and electricity information and explain any shutoff or fuel emergency.

  3. Complete verification

    Respond to your local provider’s document requests.
sections.after: Check the application’s status with the provider. Do not assume a submitted form stops disconnection.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Current EAP application and documents; EAP benefits. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

Where do I report an emergency?
In the application and directly to the provider.
